Read `./backend/AGENTS.md` and `./frontend/AGENTS.md`; inspect package scripts and `.github/workflows/*`. Express: `backend/index.js`, `backend/src/routes/*.js`, `backend/src/controllers/*`, `backend/src/repositories/repository.factory.js`. React: `frontend/src/lib/api.js`, `frontend/src/pages/admin/adminhomes.jsx`. `backend/.env.examples` documents configuration.

Cookie-first auth: never rely on localStorage tokens in production. FormData: do not set `Content-Type` manually. Always double check `credentials: 'include'`. Prefer `RepositoryFactory`.

When running backend npm tests locally always comment out the `MONGO_URI` environment variable in the `.env` file at the `./backend` folder make sure it was not declared and just un-comment it back after testing, Also skip cloudinary test cases if at least one of the following environment variables is not set, is empty or is not present in the `.env` file: `IMAGE_STORAGE_TYPE`, `CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME`, `CLOUDINARY_API_KEY` and `CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET`.

`cd backend && npm run dev`; `cd frontend && npm start`; `cd backend && npm test`. `backend/.env` (do not commit secrets).
